findings.finding: The plan says to assert the 'fit-then-normalize ordering' for the shared mapper through `WikiTextCodec`, 'mirroring what `test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py` does for `AdfCodec`'. However, `WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound` is the identity function (returns the string unchanged), so `normalize(fit(v)) == fit(normalize(v)) == fit(v)` is trivially true for all inputs. A test that merely asserts `normalize(fit(v)) == fit(v)` cannot distinguish correct ordering from a swapped ordering — a regression that swaps `fit` and `normalize` in `OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote` would still pass. The plan does not acknowledge this structural difference from the ADF case, where `normalize_outbound` genuinely transforms the text (soft-wrap rejoin).
findings.location: Acceptance criteria — 'the shared `OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote` is exercised through `WikiTextCodec` with the fit-then-normalize ordering asserted'; Approach section — 'Driving the shared mapper through the DC codec is part of this story'

findings.finding: The plan's AC3 asserts the shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote will be exercised through WikiTextCodec with 'the fit-then-normalize ordering asserted, mirroring what test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py does for AdfCodec.' This is an unverified capability claim: WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound is the identity function (returns text unchanged unconditionally), so composing normalize_outbound(fit_outbound(v)) is always equal to fit_outbound(v) for any v. The ordering that is load-bearing for AdfCodec (where normalization rejoins soft-wrapped ADF paragraphs and produces a materially different result) is vacuous for WikiTextCodec — no mutation of the ordering would produce a distinct observable value. A test written to 'assert the fit-then-normalize ordering' through WikiTextCodec cannot falsify a swap of the two steps, which means the pin does not achieve what the plan claims it does.
findings.location: Acceptance criteria, AC3: 'the shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is exercised through WikiTextCodec with the fit-then-normalize ordering asserted'
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the ordering-assertion framing in AC3 with: 'the shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is exercised through WikiTextCodec and the following DC-specific description behaviours are pinned by value: (i) a string description over WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is truncated with the " … [truncated by reconciler]" suffix; (ii) a string description at or below the limit passes through unchanged; (iii) a non-string description bypasses WikiTextCodec entirely. Note: the fit-then-normalize ordering is not independently observable through WikiTextCodec because normalize_outbound is the identity — no separate ordering assertion is needed or possible.'
